body:
Edge Wallet integrates with Simplex, enabling users to purchase cryptocurrencies seamlessly within the app.

Accepted Payment Methods

Buy Crypto:

  • Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard) ~5-7% • Settlement: ~10-30 Minutes

  • Apple Pay (iOS devices) ~5-7% • Settlement: ~10-30 Minutes

  • Google Pay (Android devices) ~5-7% • Settlement: ~10-30 Minutes

Sell Crypto:

*Note: Payment method availability varies by country and region.

Supported Regions

Simplex's services are accessible in over 190 countries. However, certain regions are restricted due to regulatory reasons.

Supported Regions Include:

  • North America: United States (excluding Hawaii, New York, Louisiana, Alaska, Nevada, New Mexico, Washington, Vermont, Florida), Canada

  • Europe: United Kingdom, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, and more

  • Asia-Pacific: Australia, New Zealand, South Korea, Japan, and others

  • Latin America: Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Chile, and more

  • Africa: South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, and others

Getting Started

  1. Open Edge Wallet: Launch the Edge Wallet app on your device.

  2. Navigate to Buy/Sell: Tap on the "Buy" or "Sell" option.

  3. Select Your Region: Tap "Select Region" and choose your country/state.

  4. Select Simplex: Choose Simplex as your service provider.

  5. Enter Details: Input the required information and follow the prompts to complete your transaction.
